name: Johnson County, KS
findings: Johnson County has 2,367 nonprofit organizations. 1,009 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 820 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Johnson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 96 professional organizations here list membership, compared with about 33 in similar places of this size.
